data.desc: The Western Union Company (NYSE: WU) is committed to helping people and businesses move money globally. Our leading cross-border, cross-currency money movement, payments and digital financial services platform empowers consumers, businesses, financial institutions and governments across more than 200 countries and territories and over 130 currencies. We connect consumers, businesses, financial institutions and governments through one of the world's broadest global networks, reaching billions of bank accounts, digital wallets and cards, and a substantial global retail footprint. Western Union connects the world to bring boundless possibilities within reach.
